source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet, math section, WITH the teacher's official graded worked solutions (pages 2-6 of the PDF).
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned PDF (Claude Code), 2026-09-07

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា
exams.note: Printed header reads ' ពិន្ទុ : ១២៥' (125 points; matches backend/data/bacii-exam/limits/2018.json's prior extraction). No per-question point breakdown is printed on the paper itself; the per-question split used by the marking scheme (engine/topics/past_exam/rubric.py) — I:10, II:15, III:15, IV:15, V:25, VI:10, VII:35, summing to 125 — was supplied directly rather than derived from the source.

sections.title_km: ប្រូបាបប៊ីលីតេ
sections.given_km: ក្នុងប្រអប់មួយមានឡុងពណ៌ស 2, ពណ៌ក្រហម 4, ពណ៌ខៀវ 4។ ចាប់ 3 ព្រមគ្នាដោយចៃដន្យ។
sections.given_en: A box has 2 white, 4 red, and 4 blue balls. Draw 3 simultaneously at random.

questions.label: B
questions.prompt_en: P(B): at least 2 of the 3 balls are blue.

questions.label: C
questions.prompt_en: P(C): the 3 balls are all different colors.

engine.note: Already live in engine/topics/limit/data/curated/{factoring_0_0,sinc_standard_limit,angle_addition_0_0}.json, ids 2018a/2018b/2018c, from a prior extraction pass.

sections.title_km: កំណត់ចំនួនកុំផ្លិច

engine.note: Irrational (sqrt) coefficients are outside the existing complex topic's plain-integer a+bi solver.

questions.label: b
questions.prompt_en: Write z1*z2 and (z1/z2)^2 in trigonometric form.

sections.title_km: គណនាអាំងតេក្រាល

engine.note: Generic definite-integral solver; no curated-bank wiring needed (matches how integrals are treated elsewhere in this repo).

sections.title_km: វិចលនិងធរណីមាត្រវិភាគ

engine_a.note: Raw vector/point answers aren't a shape the existing vectors_space topic's ops return (they return a scalar magnitude/dot/area); graded via the new 'vector' answer_kind added to engine/core/grading.py.

questions_a.prompt_en: Show A, B, C are not collinear.
Show n=(0,1,-1) is a normal vector of plane ABC.

engine_b.note: This equation's own algebra cancels every cross/linear term once expanded (a centered, axis-aligned ellipse) -- a bespoke reduction, not the general parabola/ellipse/hyperbola classifier already owned by the 'conics' topic.

questions_b.prompt_en: Reduce to standard form; find a, b.

sections.title_km: សមីការឌីផេរង់ស្យែល

engine.note: Existing topic already supports this kind + initial conditions verbatim.

questions.label: b
questions.prompt_en: Find the particular solution given y(0)=3, y'(0)=-3.

engine.note: The exam restricts the domain to (1,+oo) by fiat (the expression's own natural domain is (-oo,-1) U (1,oo)); the existing functions topic derives domain purely from the expression and doesn't support an external restriction, and doesn't support a polynomial-plus-log expr shape for its monotonicity/position machinery.

questions.label: kh
questions.prompt_en: Show f'(x); show f is decreasing on (1,+oo); build the variation table.

questions.label: got.1
questions.prompt_en: Show d1: y=-x+4 is an asymptote of C as x->+oo.

questions.label: got.2
questions.prompt_en: Show (x+1)/(x-1)>1 on (1,+oo); deduce the position of C relative to d1.
questions.answer_latex: \text{C lies above } d_1 \text{ on all of } (1,+\infty)

questions.label: gn
questions.prompt_en: Find the point where the tangent d2 has slope -5/3; write d2's equation.

questions.label: ng
questions.prompt_en: Sketch C with d1 and d2 (ln3~1.1; C crosses the x-axis near (4.5,0)).
